models.name: ConvNeXt-T IN-1k · robust fold ensemble (upgrade default)
models.description: Chosen by cross-validation: Highest pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 among candidates (single recipes with/without 8-view TTA, and probability ensembles of 2-3 recipes) whose estimated CPU time for the whole fold ensemble is <= 1000 ms per photo; ties within 0.001 go to higher out-of-fold accuracy, then lower latency. Decided on out-of-fold data only; the test set is scored once afterwards.

gradcam.summary: Mean share of Grad-CAM mass on the leaf (leaf mask from saturation thresholding): Tomato Care · Deep learning (5 conditions) 78%.

limitations: One phone model, two districts of Rajasthan, single leaves on paper: accuracy on field photos, other cameras or regions is unknown.
Five conditions only: the dataset's Early Blight (62 photos), Late Blight and Potassium Deficiency (9 photos) were too hard to recognise reliably and are not diagnosed.
Nitrogen Deficiency has 45 photographs (8 in the test set): its per-class scores are very uncertain.
The test set is small (265 photos of the five conditions); differences of a few points are within noise — read the confidence intervals and paired tests.
The same test photos were used to report the original study, so they are not perfectly fresh; no upgrade decision used them.
Calibration and thresholds were fitted on out-of-fold predictions; coverage on new photos can still differ.
The deep-learning model learned to refuse the dataset's other three conditions (outlier exposure); diseases it has never seen may still receive a diagnosis. The classical model had no such training.
Out-of-dataset checks used PlantVillage leaves (another lab), everyday photos and synthetic stress tests; field photos with complex backgrounds were not available.
Grad-CAM shows where the network looked, not why a leaf is diseased; the classical model has no Grad-CAM.

5class.why: macro-F1 within 0.01 of the best (A, D): lowest out-of-fold NLL

reference.label: v2 networks without outlier exposure (reference only)

final_round.note: Final pipelines fixed on out-of-fold data (scripts/36, rules in docs/AUDIT.md §6) and scored here once on the test photos. The test photos had been used for reporting in earlier rounds (v1, v2, v2.1), never for a choice.
